## Validation

## Change checklist

- [ ] Tests cover changed behavior, or no test is reasonably applicable
- [ ] English and German translations are updated, or no user-facing text changed
- [ ] A migration is included, or no database schema changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` is updated, or the change is not user-visible
- [ ] Screenshots are included for visible UI changes
- [ ] Documentation is updated for changed behavior or configuration
- [ ] No secrets, private data, or unrelated generated files are included
